chat.empty: Pick a graph and start the conversation.

operate.placeholder: e.g. create a user named Grace Hopper in the CRM

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Live capability catalog — everything the system currently knows how to do.
skills.empty: No skills connected. Start one and it will register itself here.

config.restartRequiredHint: Changing this only takes effect the next time the skill process starts.

projections.title: Projections
projections.subtitle: Existing systems exposed as skills — no code changes on their side.
projections.name: Name (optional)
projections.baseUrl: Base URL (optional if the spec declares servers)
projections.empty: No projections yet. Connect an existing API and its operations become skills.
projections.writeWarning: live mode performs REAL writes on the target system

graphs.title: Graphs
graphs.subtitle: Registered IR graphs — declared by humans or generated by planners.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every session with its causal log — click one to inspect the chain (cause_id → id).

voice.title: Voice
voice.subtitle: Speak to a graph. Interrupt it any time — it stops.
voice.halfDuplexHelp: Stops the microphone while the assistant talks. Use it if the assistant interrupts itself through your speakers; headphones solve the same problem.
voice.empty: Press start and say something. What you say appears as you speak it.
voice.requires: Needs a microphone and the voice graph running: skills/asr, skills/llm-chat, skills/sentence-chunker and skills/tts.
voice.insecureContext: A microphone needs a secure context. localhost works; a LAN address over plain http:// does not — use https or open the UI on the machine itself.

canvas.irTitle: C2 graph IR — edit and apply, or copy out
canvas.hint: Pick a skill from the palette to place it. Drag from an output port to an input port to wire an edge. Scroll to zoom, drag the background to pan.

status.blocked: {{count}} error(s) must be resolved before this graph can be registered.

palette.empty: No skill in the catalogue matches. A fresh node has an empty catalogue until skills connect to it.

inspector.nothing: Select a node or an edge to see what it declares.
inspector.refHelp: This node's local name inside the graph. Lowercase, digits, dash or underscore.
inspector.resolveHelp: A demand the kernel satisfies at instantiation. Prefer this over a package: it lets the node degrade to another provider.
inspector.useHelp: Pin an exact package instead of a capability. Overrides resolve.
inspector.clientNote: The client pseudo-node is the external application connection. C2 implies it from the edges that name it, so it is never written into nodes[] and cannot be removed.
inspector.gateHelp: human-approval holds the message until a person confirms. Node policy may add one regardless; a graph can ask for more scrutiny, never less.
inspector.gateMotorHelp: This destination acts on the world. C2 rule 5 means the kernel adds a human-approval gate when none is declared — in published mode it refuses the session instead.
inspector.qosReliable: one ordered stream, FIFO per edge
inspector.qosRealtime: datagram; cannot stall or be stalled
inspector.speculativeHelp: Deliver on partial upstream output and discard the work if the final output differs. Refused into a motor skill, and refused alongside a human-approval gate.
inspector.deadlineHelp: How long a delivery here is worth waiting for. Absolute once on the wire; a later hop may tighten it, never extend it.
inspector.priorityHelp: Higher wins when two chains contend for the same skill.
